PASS: #283 security round 1 at e38a9be31ec4076c3204c7c8de607d9beb978ef9, base 46106685eee34a73cb26223d05cb2199c40b715b.

No introduced security vulnerability or C21 disclosure was identified in the seven-file delta. This review applies C32/C33's user-account trust boundary and C34's scoped review contract, not new per-seat credential isolation.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerabilities found | - |

Source evidence:

- Chain confinement: carry.rs:92-114 proves present/equal launch IDs and native-boundary links with a live endpoint; :280-283 passes only its retired seats as via. community/directory.rs:2306-2327 looks up the latest holding by seat and instance and follows an ended row only when its exact "carried to" destination is in via. :2338-2345 requires an ended terminal row to name the actual endpoint. Another launch's seat is not added merely because governance mentions it.
- The walk is bounded, not an immutable-incarnation authentication mechanism. It uses current registry identity and latest holding identity; membership does not impose forward ordering. Cycles cannot cause an unbounded traversal: governance traversal has via.len()+1 iterations. This review does not claim exhaustive concurrent-ID-reuse coverage or a new per-seat security boundary.
- Exact holding ends: store/community.rs:265-268 ends and inserts the recovered ended row within the existing transaction. :449-489 binds project, role, instance, seat and from_at, with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on insertion. A different instance, seat or start identity is not ended by that row. Governance is authoritative for the identical key; this is not a blanket live-seat veto.
- Predecessor finish: carry.rs:508-530 selects same-launch native predecessors; each subsequently uses the normal carry guard. :471 uses Redo and :229-231 returns without mutation when no intent exists. Attempts serialize at :227; :196-205 matches completion to intent sequence and empty delivering, :238-243 skips completed holdings/mail work, and :548-563 makes boot use Redo too. Execution may repeat; effects are idempotent, rather than tasks executing exactly once.
- Bounds/cost: MAX_HOPS is 16 (carry.rs:75). Predecessor discovery scans a finite full roster with at most 16 candidate searches (:516-529), hence up to 16N candidate inspection for N registry rows, then at most 16 predecessor attempts plus the new boundary. Each uses intent/spine matching (:173-199). Roster, scope, holders and underlying spine-query sizes are not constant bounds. No new recurring timer, per-tick/per-seat launch or process-launch site was identified; added work is at a native boundary, not at rest. No live deploy or before/after fleet cost measurement was performed by this security review.
- Public-content/injection review: no new credential literals, private owner/content disclosure, machine paths outside pij's layout, sensitive files or dependency changes. No credential files read. No new shell construction: inherited Git arguments use Command (community/git.rs:35-49), and role-path grammar remains checked (community/layout.rs:110-135).

Execution evidence:

1. `just pr-freeze 283`: PASS at the full head above; repeated before publication. Exact-head CI run 44695730418: check(22), check(24), rust-lint and rust-test SUCCESS; delivers run 44695730269 SUCCESS.
2. `PIJ_SHARED_TARGET="$(bash harness/scripts/cargo-target.sh)" just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-daemon --test directory_http carry -- --nocapture --then test --locked -p pij-store carry -- --nocapture`: exit 0. Daemon carry selection 9/9 PASS. The store name filter ran one unrelated fleet-history test; it is not claimed as separate carry-index proof. The real index behavior is exercised by daemon integration tests.
3. `PIJ_SHARED_TARGET="$(bash harness/scripts/cargo-target.sh)" just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-daemon --test directory_http clear -- --nocapture`: exit 0, 6/6 PASS, including all three added tests: reviewer_r2_second_clear_after_git_before_index_is_recovered; a_second_clear_finishes_the_cut_carry_before_its_own; a_later_clear_never_carries_an_earlier_boundary_without_an_intent.
4. Own isolated mutation, no frozen-checkout edits: carry.rs:471, predecessor Start::Redo -> Start::New. `PIJ_SHARED_TARGET=<shared-target> just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-daemon --test directory_http a_later_clear_never_carries_an_earlier_boundary_without_an_intent -- --exact --nocapture`: exit 101, one test executed and failed as expected. At directory_http.rs:10718 the unstarted predecessor's open holding count was 0, expected 1. This proves the no-backfill guard is tested. Mutation restored.
5. After restoration, command (3) rebuilt the unchanged frozen checkout into the shared target and passed 6/6 again. No mutant artifacts are claimed as clean proof. Builds/tests used shared-build's lock, nice19 and four jobs. Disposable mutation worktree removed.
6. `harness boot --json`: advisory ready:false, missing JS dependencies. `harness checks --json`: exit 1 overall, completed 2026-11-20T07:59:18.734Z, no stages skipped. PASS: Rust fmt/clippy/workspace tests, route inventory, smoke, native Copilot contracts, installed SDK and pij-skill. FAIL8: local-paths, omp-config, ddocs, coverage and lockfile lacked tsx (127); typecheck exited 2; ambient Biome rejected includes (1); vitest module missing (1). Attribution WARN127. C25 respected: no dependency install or node_modules symlink. This is not a green local ship gate; exact-head CI supplies the JS proof.
